title: dogfood reports PARTIAL_SUCCESS because it treats enqueue as completion (no wait, premature validation)
body: core/dogfood.run() enqueues the pipeline (async, status='enqueued') then immediately validates the baseline worktree; the PASS rule requires pipeline.status=='enqueued' and the pipeline is never waited on, so dogfood cannot observe a completed, passing product.

rcca.root_cause: dogfood.run() treats an async enqueue as completion: it validates before the pipeline runs and its verdict rule never requires an observed terminal pipeline state.
rcca.corrective: Drive the run to completion (bounded wait), validate the generated product dir, and map terminal states fail-closed (BI-PF-1278); ensure the DOGFOOD quality-gate record (BI-PF-1279).
rcca.preventive: Verdict must derive from an observed terminal pipeline state + post-run validation; add a test that dogfood never returns PASS without a completed run and a passing validation.
